items.sentence: The audit team compared infection rates across three wards because the sample sizes finally reached statistical significance.
Quality engineers quantified defect rates on the new press line before approving the tooling change.
The line supervisor quantified scrap weight per shift to isolate which station drove the waste.
The pharmacy log noted the barcode scanner could not read three labels during the morning shift.
Consequently, the warehouse team recalculated the reorder point after measuring three months of demand data.
Consequently, the agency measured response times across every precinct before proposing the staffing change.
Nurses measured turnaround time on lab results across two shifts to see where the delay accumulated.
The literacy program combined the reading coach's cueing system with the math tutor's pacing chart.
The treasury team merged the cash-forecasting method from retail with the seasonal model used in agriculture.
Cross-training let the ICU nurses apply the sepsis checklist the ER team had already refined.
The dispatcher linked the weather-delay rule from the airline industry to the trucking schedule.
The lending team combined the credit-scoring approach from microloans with the mortgage underwriting model.
The assembly team adapted the kitchen's mise-en-place habit to prep stations before each shift.
The intake form includes an important field for allergies, current medications and the date of the last visit.
The syllabus describes six units, each with a reading list and a short weekly quiz.
The ledger entry represents a routine deposit; the teller noted no issue with the batch total.
The zoning map defines three districts, each with its own setback and height rule.
The config file has an important settings section covering database connection and timeout values.
The transcript includes an important note about the credit hours converted from the transfer school.
The discharge summary lists the diagnosis, the medications prescribed and the follow-up date.
The warehouse layout marks an important clearance path along aisle six for forklift traffic.
The rubric describes four performance levels, from beginning to advanced, for each criterion.
The maintenance log has a column for the date, the technician and the parts replaced.
The report describes the survey method, the sample size and the response rate.
The reviewer flagged the staffing gap as a significant risk to weekend coverage.
The committee judged the old triage rule better suited to a smaller emergency room.
The audit called the manual counting step a critical risk in the receiving process.
The engineer argued the new fixture is a clear advantage over the old jig.
The principal argued the block schedule is better for labs but worse for short subjects.
The architect said the shared database is a significant risk to the team's release speed.
The pharmacist argued the new labeling is a meaningful improvement in dosing safety.
Engineers proposed a breakthrough fixture that could cut changeover time by more than half.
The team pioneered a novel caching scheme that could reshape how the checkout flow performs.
What if triage ran on a rotating pod model instead of the fixed-desk layout.
The plant envisioned a modular line that could be reconfigured overnight for a new product.
The team pioneered an innovative escrow structure that might redefine how small deals close.
The city imagined a radical transit redesign built entirely around on-demand shuttle pods.
What if the onboarding flow transformed into a single guided conversation instead of six forms.
